svg.title: CME-CAD reasoning correction diagram
svg.desc: Inventory: a dashed top input-images frame contains three gray CAD dimension sketches and one shaded triangular-prism model. Three rounded reasoning boxes below contain red Wrong Answer stamps, think tags, icons, multi-line explanations with colored emphasis, and are connected by black curved arrows from the input origin. Curved arrows from the wrong boxes converge to a CME-CAD robot icon, which leads to a green final answer bar at the bottom. Symmetry basis: the three reasoning boxes are horizontally aligned and nearly equally partitioned around a central vertical axis through the input origin, middle box, robot, and output bar. Confirmed SAM mappings: top-right model draft_model_3d -> asset_sam_region_000028; left icon draft_icon_purple -> asset_sam_region_000024; middle portrait draft_icon_person -> asset_sam_region_000026; right OpenAI icon draft_icon_openai -> asset_sam_region_000023; robot draft_robot -> asset_sam_region_000025. Red P-board labels are annotation metadata and are not reproduced.
